title: The repeatable grace check 'climb for the scrap (grace, 1hp on fail)' failed four times running (-4hp total) with only 'It can be tried again' as feedback each time — no cap, no rising odds, no hint that stopping might be wiser, so a player can bleed hp indefinitely chasing a minor loot item.
where: Crow Perch, action 'climb for the scrap'
